claims.object_text: early-onset, mostly intractable epilepsy and severe intellectual disability
claims.quote: CDKL5 deficiency disorder (CDD) and SMC1A-related epilepsy are X-linked neurodevelopmental disorders characterized by early-onset, mostly intractable epilepsy and severe intellectual disability.

claims.object_text: clusters of focal impaired awareness, myoclonic, and tonic-clonic seizures at 19 and 20 months of age
claims.quote: The two girls with SMC1A mosaicism presented clusters of focal impaired awareness, myoclonic, and tonic-clonic seizures at 19 and 20 months of age.
They demonstrated milder intellectual disabilities, with one achieving normal speech and the other speaking over 100 words by age four.
Both achieved independent walking, which is uncommon in germline patients.

claims.object_text: same epilepsy phenotype as the germline females but have milder intellectual and motor disabilities compared to germline patients
claims.quote: Girls with mosaic CDKL5 and SMC1A variants share the same epilepsy phenotype as the germline females but have milder intellectual and motor disabilities compared to germline patients.
